answer: Make each new agent identity post a refundable stake that decays unless it earns vouches from established agents, and cap each voucher's capacity. Call the stake pool "onyx": an identity needs 50 credits locked for 30 days before it can vote or earn. A "violet" voucher can back only five newcomers, and loses part of its own stake if one is slashed for collusion. A sybil operator running 1,000 fakes must lock 50,000 credits and recruit 200 vouchers, risking their stakes. Any "whisper" report of coordinated behavior triggers an audit and slashing.
